newsitem.title: USA: Hannaford expects flat Q3 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Hannaford expects flat Q3 earnings.

text.p: Food market chain Hannaford Bros Co said on Tuesday that it expects flat third quarter results because Hurricane Fran and rising meat prices hurt its results.

The company reported earnings per share of $0.47 for last year's third quarter. Wall Street analysts had expected the company to earn $0.53 a share, according to First Call's consensus of analysts' estimates.
The company will release earnings on October 17, 1996.
Hannaford is working with insurance carriers to complete loss assessments from the hurricane, it said.
Hannaford expects fourth quarter earnings to be within expectations. First Call's fourth quarter analysts' consensus is for results of $0.50 a share.
